questions.question:
What does this Python 3 program print?

```python
a = [1, 2, 3]
b = a
c = a[:]

b[0] = 5
c.append(a[0])

print(sum(a), sum(c))
```

A SQL table `events(user_id, points)` contains:

| user_id | points |
|---:|---:|
| 1 | 10 |
| 1 | NULL |
| 2 | 10 |
| 3 | 20 |
| 4 | NULL |

What single row does this query return?

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(points), COUNT(DISTINCT points)
FROM events
WHERE user_id <= 3;
```

Assume `work()` takes constant time and `n` is an integer greater than 1. What is the tight time complexity?

```python
i = 1
while i < n:
    for j in range(i):
        work()
    i *= 2
```

A directed graph has exactly these weighted edges:

| Edge | Weight | Edge | Weight |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| A -> B | 4 | B -> E | 4 |
| A -> C | 2 | E -> D | 1 |
| C -> B | 1 | D -> F | 2 |
| B -> D | 5 | E -> F | 7 |
| C -> D | 9 | C -> F | 12 |

What is the minimum total weight of a directed path from A to F?
Two independent fair six-sided dice are rolled. Given that their sum is 8, what is the probability that at least one die shows a 3?
Suppose 3x + 2y = 19 and x - y = 3. What is x^2 - y^2?
A disease affects 1% of a population. A test has 90% sensitivity and 95% specificity. A randomly selected individual tests positive. What is the probability they actually have the disease?
Four observations are 2, 4, 4, and 6. What is their sample variance, with the n-1 denominator?
How many four-digit decimal strings can be formed using four distinct digits, with exactly two even digits and a nonzero first digit? The digit 0 is considered even.
What is the smallest nonnegative integer n satisfying all three congruences: n = 2 (mod 5), n = 3 (mod 7), and n = 4 (mod 9)?
All raals are sils. No sils are zeks. At least one raal exists. Which statement necessarily follows?

choices.A: At least one raal is not a zek.

questions.question: Four tasks A, B, C, and D must be done in some order, each exactly once. A must occur before C. B must occur immediately before D. C cannot be last. Which sequence satisfies all three rules?

Three people A, B, and C each make a statement that is either true or false.

A says: "B's statement is false."
B says: "C's statement is false."
C says: "Both A's and B's statements are false."

Who is telling the truth?
Three switches P, Q, and R are each ON or OFF. Exactly two are ON. If P is ON, R must be ON. If Q is ON, R must be OFF. Which switch must be OFF?

choices.B: No assignment can satisfy the rules

questions.question:
Consider these four statements:

1. Exactly two of these four statements are true.
2. Statement 1 is false.
3. Statement 2 is true.
4. Statement 3 is false.

Which pair of statements is true?
How many binary strings of length 8 contain exactly three 1 bits, with no two 1 bits adjacent?
An ideal 12-volt battery is connected across two resistors in parallel, one 3 ohms and the other 6 ohms. What total current does the battery supply?
Hydrogen reacts with oxygen: 2 H2 + O2 -> 2 H2O. Initially 5 moles of H2 and 2 moles of O2 are available. If the limiting reactant is fully consumed, how many moles of water form?

Two parents both have genotypes AaBb. The two genes assort independently, and uppercase alleles are dominant. What is the probability that their offspring has genotype aa and at least one dominant B allele?

A sealed mineral sample originally contained 80 atoms of a radioactive parent isotope and zero atoms of its stable daughter product. It now has 20 parent atoms and 60 daughter atoms. Assume the daughter arises only from that decay and none has escaped. How many half-lives elapsed?

A pipeline has two stages. Stage 1 takes exactly 3 ms per item; Stage 2 takes exactly 7 ms per item. The stages can process different items concurrently; each stage processes one item at a time, in order. There is unlimited buffering and no overhead. Starting both stages idle, what minimum time is needed to finish 10 items?

A channel independently flips each bit with probability 0.1. A sender transmits the same bit three times, and the receiver decodes by majority vote. What is the probability the decoded bit is incorrect?

A company processes requests as follows: Requests submitted before 16:00 on a business day are processed on the next business day. Requests submitted at or after 16:00 on a business day are processed on the second business day after submission. Business days are Monday–Friday. There are no holidays this week or next. A request is submitted Thursday at exactly 16:00. When will it be processed?

A website has the following results:

| Period | Visitors | Purchases |
|---|---:|---:|
| Week A | 200 | 20 |
| Week B | 120 | 18 |

Each purchase represents a distinct visitor. Which week has the higher visitor-to-purchase conversion rate, and by how many percentage points?

A study observes 120 students, who choose for themselves whether to use a study-planning application. Users score 8 points higher on average than nonusers. The study makes no statistical adjustment and does not randomly assign participation. Which conclusion is justified?

choices.B: Every nonuser would gain 8 points by using the app.
choices.C: Users averaged 8 points higher, but causation is not established.
choices.E: Every application user outscored every nonuser.

questions.question: There are four editors and six manuscripts. Every editor reviewed at least one manuscript. No manuscript was reviewed by all four editors. Which statement must be true?

choices.A: Some manuscript was reviewed by all four editors.
choices.B: Each editor reviewed exactly one manuscript.
choices.C: No manuscript was reviewed by more than one editor.
choices.D: Some editor reviewed all six manuscripts.
choices.E: For each manuscript, at least one editor did not review it.

questions.question:
Two hospitals report:

| Hospital | Mild cases recovered | Severe cases recovered |
|---|---|---|
| A | 90 of 100 | 1 of 10 |
| B | 19 of 20 | 70 of 100 |

Which statement is correct?

choices.A: B has a higher rate in both groups, but A has a higher rate overall.
choices.B: B has a higher recovery rate in both groups and overall.
choices.C: A has a higher recovery rate in both groups and overall.
choices.D: A has a higher rate in both groups, but B has a higher rate overall.
choices.E: They have identical overall recovery rates.

questions.question: A system audit states: "Every cache entry written before noon was invalidated. Some entries written after noon were also invalidated. No invalidated entry can be served." Which conclusion necessarily follows?

choices.A: Every after-noon entry cannot be served.
choices.E: At least one after-noon entry cannot be served.
